handoff_acceptance: accepted for Track B research and prior-art review; not accepted as physiological validation or an RSG novelty claim
track_b_status: active GBFs software build: B0-B3 PASS at bounded scopes; B4-B7 PIVOT at their stated scopes; B8 IN_PROGRESS
scientific_claim_boundary: One-participant descriptive pulse-artifact localization and nominal source-signature analysis only. Fixed cortical-normal orientation is a model assumption with measured geometric mismatch; no physiological localization, calibrated recoverability, population generalization, RSG novelty, or method superiority claim.

dataset.name: Localize-MI
dataset.secondary_repeated_current_check: Five sites with 1 mA and 5 mA conditions; secondary conditions are not additional independent sites.

task_contract.target: Intracranial stimulation contact-pair midpoint for the measured pulse artifact
task_contract.primary_metric: Euclidean distance from reconstructed peak to contact-pair midpoint, with midpoint-to-cortical-grid offset reported
task_contract.secondary_metric: Descriptive predicted versus observed scalp-pattern similarity across 15 dependent site pairs
task_contract.reference: Average reference over common good channels, applied consistently to EEG, leadfield, and noise covariance
task_contract.source_orientation: Fixed cortical normal from supplied participant-specific forward model
task_contract.development_split: All runs from sub-01 are development data; no held-out participant inference.

arguments.noise_cov: positive-semidefinite sensor covariance with same channel order/reference as leadfield
arguments.coordinates: finite sources-by-3 coordinate array in metres

nominal_signature_api.interpretation: Nominal noise-whitened sensor-pattern similarity conditional on a specified leadfield, reference, and covariance. Not a calibrated probability, localization confidence region, or biological identifiability claim.

observed_development_results.inference: Descriptive only; one participant, 15 dependent pairwise rows, no p-values or generalization claim. Current topography uses peak-GFP sample; metrics supersede the pre-remediation signed-window-mean values.

reproduction.fresh_basis_generation: cold 20-mode and 300-mode geometry caches regenerated and identity-checked in the final run
reproduction.empty_venv_install_check: Fresh Python 3.12 venv, all 34 exact pins installed, pip check clean, and all 20 tests passed.

track_a_closeout.visual_qa: Static HTML and asset integrity checked; interactive browser and cross-browser rendering not certified
track_a_closeout.source_control: Workspace has no Git history or tag; the sealed source snapshot and hashes provide exact artifact identity only.

historical_track_b_gates: Complete equation-level prior-art comparison against inverse resolution analysis, robust inverse methods, uncertainty-aware source estimation, and adaptive parcellation; decide whether a distinct gap remains.
Freeze a mathematically distinct, falsifiable hypothesis and kill criterion before implementing any new score or algorithm.
Choose a task and benchmark with physically defensible targets and orientation treatment; do not use pulse-artifact localization as physiological ground truth.
Define physically defensible forward-model ensembles and nuisance handling without fitting held-out targets.
Evaluate calibration and predictive value with participant-grouped held-out data against fixed baselines; account for dependence at participant/session level.
If calibration or baseline advantage fails, report the negative result and do not claim a new framework.
